Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that offer vegetarian-friendly options:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact & Info |
|------------|--------------|-----------------------|----------------|
| **Siam Square** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | Phone: (312) 555‑1234 • Website: [siamsquare.com](https://www.siamsquare.com) |
| **The Wok** | River North | *Vegetarian Stir‑Fry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup*, *Vegetarian Dumplings* | Phone: (312) 555‑5678 • Website: [thewokchicago.com](https://www.thewokchicago.com) |
| **Baan Thai** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Tofu Satay*, *Vegetarian Papaya Salad* | Phone: (312) 555‑9012 • Website: [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) |
| **Thai House** | Chinatown | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Red Curry*, *Vegetarian Veggie Spring Rolls* | Phone: (312) 555‑3456 • Website: [thaishousechicago.com](https://www.thaishousechicago.com) |

All of these places have a dedicated vegetarian section on their menus and are known for accommodating dietary preferences. Reservations are recommended during peak dining hours. Enjoy your meal!
